title: Access request with --provision flag fails with HTTP 422 error
description: The platform rejects access requests with 'create' or 'provision' actions, only accepting 'bind' or 'grant'. This blocks the documented workflow for provisioning new credentials for APIs that don't have existing toolkits.
reproduction_steps: Observe HTTP 422 error with message: Input should be 'bind' or 'grant'
expected_behavior: The --provision flag should create a new credential and toolkit for the API, as described in documentation
actual_behavior: Platform returns HTTP 422 error rejecting 'create' and 'provision' actions, forcing users to bind to existing toolkits only
evidence: HTTP 422 error when attempting 'jentic access request --provision'; platform rejects 'create' and 'provision' actions, only accepts 'bind' or 'grant'. Agent had to bind to existing toolkit instead of provisioning new credential.

title: No CLI command available for viewing execution history
description: The platform tracks execution history but provides no CLI command to view it, forcing users to construct manual curl requests to the control plane API. This is inconsistent with other platform features that have CLI commands.
reproduction_steps: Attempt to find a 'jentic executions' or similar command
Have to use curl directly to query /v1/executions endpoint
expected_behavior: A CLI command like 'jentic executions list' should be available to view execution history
actual_behavior: No CLI command exists; users must use curl with manual token extraction
evidence: No CLI command available for viewing executions; agent had to use curl directly
Successfully queried execution records via curl; noted lack of CLI command for executions
